topic: p95 latency widgets empty after Agent config rollout
environment: Agent 7 fleet managed by configuration management
symptom_pattern: Dashboards graphing a histogram's 95th percentile went empty across many hosts after a routine config-management rollout; .avg/.max/.count still work. Customer believes metrics are being dropped by Datadog.
root_cause: The rollout changed histogram_percentiles (e.g. to 0.99 only), so the Agent stopped generating the .95percentile series. Nothing is dropped; a different set of percentile series is produced.
resolution_path: Check which <metric>.*percentile series exist in the metrics summary
Inspect histogram_percentiles in the Agent's runtime config
Restore 0.95 (or switch the app to distributions for globally accurate percentiles)
info_needed: exact metric names on the widgets

qa_pairs.tse_question: Which exact metric is on the empty widget?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: checkout.latency.95percentile. The avg one still works fine.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Did anything change in your Agent configuration around that time?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Our platform team rolled out a new datadog.yaml baseline, but it's only supposed to be log settings.

customer_style.tone: frustrated, business-impact focused, insists nothing relevant changed
